title: Slideshow gets a new wallpaper every time lock screen is shown even if slideshow interval time exceeds the itmes showing the lockscreen
line: A slideshow lock screen keeps the same image every time you lock until its change interval has passed.
explanation: Every lock starts a fresh greeter, which loads the slideshow wallpaper from scratch. In random order the slideshow always picked a new start image on load, ignoring the saved Image and the interval, so each lock showed a different picture (the same happened at every plasmashell start). The slideshow now saves when it picked the image (SlideChangeTime) next to Image; on load it shows the saved image again and only starts the timer if it was picked within the current epoch-aligned interval, otherwise it moves on as before.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: Keep the slideshow image within its interval

The slideshow starts again at every lock and plasmashell start, and in
random order it then picked a new image however long the interval was;
now it saves when it picked the image and keeps it within that interval.

BUG: 445215

media.caption: Master: random slideshow, 1 hour interval, four locks within two minutes show three different images
With the fix: same setup, every lock shows the same image
